Added com.apple.security.app-sandbox=true to both targets, plus com.apple.security.network.client on the extension target - the latter was NOT in the original plan but is empirically required: without it, WKWebView's helper processes (WebContent/GPU/Networking) crash immediately on launch ('Application does not have permission to communicate with network resources', errno=34), confirmed via /usr/bin/log stream, even for purely local/offline content. Corrected spec (markdown-quicklook-extension/spec.md - Sandboxed, least-privilege execution requirement) and design.md (Decision 4) to document this finding; actual zero-network-request behavior will be enforced via CSP in the HTML shell (task 3.1), not by omitting the entitlement.
